episodes.name: Bounty
episodes.overview: After he robbed a bank Roy accidentally gets arrested because of a minor offense, but has to be freed after a short time. Walker and Trivette stay close on his heels but they are not the only ones. The bounty hunter Maxwell is also behind Roy. When Roy is (unprovable) killed by Maxwell, Walker and Trivette follow Maxwell, who is now behind Roy's partner Ned - who has the stolen money - and doesn't stop at nothing to get the money.

episodes.name: Storm Warning
episodes.overview: Trivette goes undercover into jail to infiltrate and destroy a drug ring. During a hurricane the transport crashes; the prisoners can escape and are hiding with hostages in a remote hotel. Among the fugitives: Trivette. When the transport is overdue Walker starts searching and lands up in the hotel where he goes for the prisoners one by one with the help of a handicapped person. episodes.name: In the Name of God
episodes.overview: A desperate man named Hank Berigan asks Alex for help in persuading his daughter, Amy, to leave the cult that she has joined. When Alex goes to the cult, she is imprisoned within, realizing that once someone enters the cult, they are never allowed to leave.

episodes.name: Crime Wave Dave
episodes.overview: Walker receives a plea for help when a woman named Frances tells him how her husband, Billy, never returned home last night. Upon meeting Billy's probation officer, a man by the name of David Kilmer, Walker suspects something is very wrong.

episodes.name: End Run
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette are assigned to escort Cat, a woman who is to testify against a gang leader, Trigger James, safely to her destination. However, the group is seperated, and by the time Trivette and Cat reach said destination, they've got a nasty surprise awaiting them...

episodes.name: Family Matters
episodes.overview: Walker is not able to arrest Mick Flanders because his sister is in the Witness Protection Program. Mick, proving that he's invincible, kidnaps a boy named Archie who was staying at Walker's ranch.

episodes.name: She'll Do to Ride the River With
episodes.overview: Walker investigates the murder of a veterinarian who was trying the find the cause of death of several unusual animal deaths.

episodes.name: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: A Texas Ranger wannabe tries to upstage Walker by capturing prison escapees, buts gets innocent civilians in harm's way as well.

episodes.name: An Innocent Man
episodes.overview: Walker must find a way to prove a condemned man's guilty plea was the result of blackmail before he's executed.

episodes.name: Night of the Gladiator
episodes.overview: To get information on a gang who destroyed a friend's life via blackmail, Walker and Trivette join by posing as street fighters.

episodes.name: The Legend of Running Bear
episodes.overview: Walker's cousin, David Little Eagle Jackson, returns to the reservation following studying medicine to find many do not like him, including his girlfriend's father, whose murder he soon witnesses.

episodes.name: Something in the Shadows (1)
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette come close to apprehending the leader of a drug ring they've put out of business. Alex gets involved in the case of a student's rape.

episodes.name: Something in the Shadows (2)
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette come close to apprehending the leader of a drug ring they've put out of business. Alex gets involved in the case of a student's rape.

episodes.name: On Deadly Ground
episodes.overview: Though they've no jurisdiction there, Walker and Trivette go to Mexico to help Walker's former partner escape from Mexican criminals.

episodes.name: Right Man, Wrong Time
episodes.overview: Country-singer Merrilee needs Walker's protection from her estranged ex husband who's threatening her.

episodes.name: The Prodigal Son
episodes.overview: Walker soul searches after he nearly causes a young boy's death during a hostage situation.

episodes.name: The Committee
episodes.overview: Walker goes undercover to foil a small town's local officials, who've been taking the law into their own hands by killing the town's criminals.

episodes.name: Deadly Vision
episodes.overview: Using a psychic to help locate a kidnapped 8-year-old earns Trivette ridicule from his fellow rangers.

episodes.name: Skyjacked
episodes.overview: While transporting a condemned man from Ohio to Texas, his friends skyjack the plane and subdue Walker and Trivette, who must find a way to prevent his escape.

episodes.name: The Long Haul
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette go undercover to find out what happened to Walker's friend, a victim of a hijacking.

episodes.name: Rampage
episodes.overview: C.D. must rescue Walker and Trivette after they get trapped in Texas' backlands while tracking brothers.

episodes.name: Deadly Reunion (1)
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette get help from a legendary Texas Ranger, back to seek justice for his murdered son, to help track down an assassin with a senator in his sights.

episodes.name: Deadly Reunion (2)
episodes.overview: Walker and Trivette get help from a legendary Texas Ranger, back to seek justice for his murdered son, to help track down an assassin with a senator in his sights.

episodes.name: Stolen Lullaby
episodes.overview: A young mother's baby girl is stolen from her and illegally adopted by a rich couple who need a child to secure their political ambitions. It is up to Walker to return the girl to the rightful mother's arms, but Laurie (The young mom) withdraws consent after the shady adoption agent threatens the baby.
